description: This Java source file defines an Android application's MainActivity class, demonstrating various notification styles with user interaction capabilities and handling notification creation, styling, and user actions. It includes setup for multiple notification types such as BigText, BigPicture, Inbox, and Messaging styles, along with their associated intents and actions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: MainActivity demonstrates various notification styles in an Android app, providing UI to select notification types and trigger their creation with user interactions and actions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI components, and prepares notification manager.

methods.name: onItemSelected
methods.description: Handles spinner selection to choose notification style.

methods.name: onNothingSelected
methods.description: Placeholder for spinner's no selection state.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Triggers notification generation based on selected style after checking notification permissions.

methods.name: generateBigTextStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BIG_TEXT_STYLE notification with actions for snooze and dismiss.

methods.name: generateBigPictureStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a BIG_PICTURE_STYLE notification with inline reply support.

methods.name: generateInboxStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays an INBOX_STYLE notification summarizing multiple messages or emails.

methods.name: generateMessagingStyleNotification
methods.description: Builds and displays a MESSAGING_STYLE notification supporting chat conversation style.

methods.name: openNotificationSettingsForApp
methods.description: Opens the app's notification settings for user re-enablement.
